title: The President, Joe Biden and Ukraine

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《Dealbook》的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的真实对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行直播，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, reports of an unknown whistleblower with unnamed complaints against the president
sentences.zh: 周末期间，有报道称一名身份不明的举报人对总统提出了未具名的投诉，

sentences.en: turned into allegations that President Trump courted foreign interference from Ukraine to hurt his leading Democratic rival, Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 随后这些报道演变成指控：特朗普总统寻求乌克兰的外国干预，以打击他在民主党内的主要竞争对手乔·拜登。

sentences.en: The president is calling it a witch hunt and saying it's Biden who is engaged in corruption.
sentences.zh: 总统称这是一场政治迫害，并表示是拜登在搞腐败。

sentences.en: Mike Schmidt on whether Ukraine is shaping up to be the Russia of 2020.
sentences.zh: 迈克·施密特将为您解读乌克兰是否会成为2020版的“俄罗斯门”。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月23日，星期一。

sentences.en: Mike, take me back to when you first learn about this whistleblower complaint.
sentences.zh: 迈克，带我回到你第一次得知这个举报人投诉的时候。

sentences.en: So, earlier this month, we started to hear that there was a whistleblower that had some type of information and that Capitol Hill was struggling to get their hands on it.
sentences.zh: 本月初，我们开始听说有一位举报人掌握了某种信息，而国会山正竭力想要获取这些信息。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And then, last Wednesday, the Washington Post reported that that complaint came from someone
sentences.zh: 然后，在上周三，《华盛顿邮报》报道称，该投诉来自

sentences.en: in the intelligence community and it involved contact between the president and a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 情报界的一名人员，涉及总统与外国领导人之间的接触。

sentences.en: So, what'd you do?
sentences.zh: 所以，你们做了什么？

sentences.en: So, we jumped on the story because all of a sudden, hold on, there's someone in the intelligence
sentences.zh: 所以我们立刻介入了这个新闻，因为突然之间，等等，情报界

sentences.en: community that thinks that the president has done something so egregious that they are trying to get the word about this out somehow.
sentences.zh: 竟然有人认为总统做出了如此离谱的事情，以至于他们正千方百计试图将此事公之于众。

sentences.en: What is it that the president could have done?
sentences.zh: 总统究竟做了什么？

sentences.en: What does it involve?
sentences.zh: 这涉及什么内容？

sentences.en: What did he do that was so extreme that what appears to be a regular civil servant went so far
sentences.zh: 他究竟做了多么极端的事情，让一个看似普通的公务员不惜挺而走险，

sentences.en: far as to file a whistleblower complaint, which is very significant, on the person who leads the executive branch?
sentences.zh: 针对行政部门的最高领导人提交了一份极其重大的举报投诉？

sentences.en: So, what do you find about this complaint?
sentences.zh: 那么，你们关于这份投诉发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, what we learned about this complaint is that it had been made to someone known as the
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们关于这份投诉了解到的是，它已被提交给华盛顿行话所称的

sentences.en: Intelligence Community Inspector General, the ICIG in Washington lingo.
sentences.zh: 情报界督察长，简称ICIG。

sentences.en: He is the watchdog for the intelligence community.
sentences.zh: 他是情报界的监督员。

sentences.en: And we learn that he has looked at this allegation and found it credible.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到，他已经审查了这一指控并认为其具有可信度。

sentences.en: But, despite that, he's been unable to pass that information along to Congress, who he reports to on how he is policing and keeping a watch over the intelligence community.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，他一直无法将这些信息传递给国会——而他需要就自己对情报界的监督和监察工作向国会汇报。

sentences.en: And why is he having trouble getting this whistleblower complaint to Congress?
sentences.zh: 为什么他在将这份举报投诉提交给国会时遇到了麻烦？

sentences.en: The system is set up for whistleblowers to come forward about government wrongdoing and for that information to go to an Inspector General and for it to be reported to Congress.
sentences.zh: 现行的制度旨在让举报人站出来揭露政府的不当行为，并将这些信息交由督察长处理，再由督察长报告给国会。

sentences.en: But what happens if it involves the President of the United States and what happens if it involves potentially privileged
sentences.zh: 但如果它涉及美国总统，又或者涉及美国总统进行的

sentences.en: conversations the President of the United States was having?
sentences.zh: 可能具有行政特权的对话，情况会怎样呢？

sentences.en: What had happened is that the ICIG had been unsure how to deal with this, had looked at this and said, uh-oh, what do I do?
sentences.zh: 实际情况是，ICIG 一直不确定该如何处理此事，在查看后觉得“哎呀，我该怎么办”，

sentences.en: And had consulted with the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 于是便咨询了司法部。

sentences.en: And the Justice Department had said, no, you cannot give this to Congress.
sentences.zh: 而司法部表示：不行，你不能把这个交给国会。

sentences.en: Technically, the ICIG actually is part of the executive branch and, by extension, works for the
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，ICIG 实际上属于行政部门的一部分，因此也受雇于

sentences.en: President.
sentences.zh: 总统。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration is saying, hey, executive branch employee, you can't do anything with that.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府则表示：嘿，行政部门的雇员，你不能拿这个做任何事。

sentences.en: You work for us and we're telling you no.
sentences.zh: 你为我们工作，我们说不行就是不行。

sentences.en: So, at this point, we know that the complaint involves the President, a conversation he had with a foreign leader, and something that bothered the intelligence community.
sentences.zh: 所以，到目前为止，我们知道这份投诉涉及总统、他与一位外国领导人的通话，以及某些让情报界感到不安的事情。

sentences.en: And those three things are a potentially huge deal for any President.
sentences.zh: 对任何一位总统来说，这三件事加在一起都可能是件大事。

sentences.en: So, we dig in as hard as we can to try and find out any little bit more we can about what is in this complaint and what it relates directly to.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们尽最大努力深入挖掘，试图尽可能多地了解这份投诉的内容以及它究竟直接关联到什么。

sentences.en: And in the process of that, we learn something interesting.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，我们了解到了一件有趣的事情。

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 是什么？

sentences.en: It involves
sentences.zh: 它涉及

sentences.en: Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰。

sentences.en: And what is it about Ukraine that starts to signal what this conversation might have been about?
sentences.zh: 关于乌克兰，是什么开始暗示这场对话可能与此有关的呢？

sentences.en: So, there are two pretty interesting data points.
sentences.zh: 这里有两个非常有趣的数据点。

sentences.en: The first is that for several months, the United States, through Trump, has been withholding hundreds of millions of dollars in aid that the
sentences.zh: 首先是几个月来，美国一直通过特朗普扣押着数亿美元的援助资金，而

sentences.en: Ukrainians say that they need to protect their own sovereignty and protect themselves from the
sentences.zh: 乌克兰人表示，他们需要这笔资金来保护自己的主权并抵御

sentences.en: Russians.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人。

sentences.en: And that brings us to the second data point about Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了关于乌克兰的第二个数据点。

sentences.en: And that's that in the past several months, as the President and his surrogates have moved their attention towards attacking Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 那就是在过去几个月里，随着总统及其幕僚将注意力转向攻击乔·拜登。

sentences.en: We happen to have the man in the middle tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚我们正好请到了这位身处风暴中心的人。

sentences.en: The President's supporters, specifically his personal lawyer, Rudy Giuliani.
sentences.zh: 总统的支持者，尤其是他的私人律师鲁迪·朱利安尼。

sentences.en: Good to have you on the show.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来节目。

sentences.en: I'm glad I'm on tonight because what you just said is totally erroneous, have been pushing the notion that when Biden got the prosecutor fired, the new
sentences.zh: 我很高兴今晚能来，因为你刚才说的话完全是错误的——他们一直在推销这样一种观点：当拜登迫使那位检察官被解职时，新上任的、经拜登批准的检察官（你在一个外国连检察官都无权批准，除非有什么见不得人的勾当正在发生），

sentences.en: prosecutor who Biden approved, you don't get to approve a prosecutor in a foreign country unless something fishy is going on.
sentences.zh: 总统候选人乔·拜登与乌克兰有着腐败的联系，因此必须接受调查。

sentences.en: The presidential candidate, Joe Biden, has corrupt ties to the Ukraine and needs to be investigated because of that.
sentences.zh: 新上任的检察官撤销了案件，不仅针对拜登的孩子和那家涉案公司。

sentences.en: The new prosecutor dropped the case, not just on Biden's kid and the crooked company.
sentences.zh: 以及拜登的孩子工作过的那家涉案公司，布里斯马。

sentences.en: And the crooked company that Biden's kid worked for, Burisma.
sentences.zh: 那是在2016年10月该家伙被整倒之后作为正式记录完成的。

sentences.en: That was done as a matter of record in October of 2016 after the guy got tanked.
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼试图利用的事实是，拜登的儿子亨特曾是一家被指控有不当行为的乌克兰能源公司的董事会成员。

sentences.en: What Giuliani has tried to exploit is the fact that Biden's son, Hunter, was on the board of a Ukrainian energy company that has been accused of wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 朱利安尼基本上一直在说，当拜登担任副总统时，他施压要求罢免乌克兰的一名检察官，目的是阻止该检察官

sentences.en: And Giuliani has essentially been saying that when Biden was vice president, he pushed to have a prosecutor in Ukraine fired in order to prevent the prosecutor
sentences.zh: 调查与其儿子在那里的商业交易相关的指控。

sentences.en: from looking into allegations related to his son's business dealings there.
sentences.zh: 而你们却不予报道。

sentences.en: And you won't cover it.
sentences.zh: 你们却只想报道我敦促乌克兰政府调查腐败这一荒谬的指控。

sentences.en: And you want to cover some ridiculous charge that I urged the Ukrainian government to investigate corruption.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我确实这么做了。

sentences.en: Well, I did.
sentences.zh: 而且我为此感到骄傲。

sentences.en: And I'm proud of it.
sentences.zh: 当然，这自然是为了让乔·拜登的总统竞选难堪并对其造成打击。

sentences.en: And that, of course, would be in the service of embarrassing and hurting Joe Biden's presidential candidacy.
sentences.zh: 他们对此毫不掩饰。

sentences.en: They don't make any bones about it.
sentences.zh: 他们就是要在这个2020年大选中击败他，并且毫不掩饰他们正试图破坏他的竞选活动。

sentences.en: They're out to defeat him in 2020 and are fairly open about the fact that they are trying to hurt his candidacy.
sentences.zh: 他们视他为特朗普竞选连任的最大潜在威胁。

sentences.en: They see him as potentially the biggest threat to a Trump re-election.
sentences.zh: 迈克，就我们目前所能了解到的，朱利安尼关于拜登的儿子以及拜登所采取行动的说法，有任何合法依据吗？

sentences.en: And Mike, is there any legitimacy, as best we can tell, to what Giuliani is saying about Biden's son and what action Biden took?
sentences.zh: 从我们目前所看到的来看，没有任何证据来支持朱利安尼的这些说法。

sentences.en: From what we can see, there's no evidence to back up these claims by Giuliani.
sentences.zh: 事实上，罢免这位检察官并不是乔·拜登一个人的决定。

sentences.en: And in fact, it wasn't Joe Biden's decision to have this prosecutor removed.
sentences.zh: 许多世界领导人和组织当时都在呼吁将这位检察官撤职。

sentences.en: Many world leaders and organizations were calling for this prosecutor to be ousted.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么鉴于我们对乌克兰已有了解的这些数据点，它怎么会与这起举报人投诉联系起来呢？

sentences.en: OK, so given those data points of the things we already knew about Ukraine, how does it connect back to this whistleblower complaint?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们开始琢磨：乌克兰人想要这笔钱、特朗普一直在扣着这笔钱、以及特朗普希望乌克兰人调查此事，

sentences.en: Well, we're starting to wonder whether the fact that the Ukrainians wanted this money, that Trump was holding back on it, and that Trump wanted the Ukrainians to investigate this
sentences.zh: 这三者是否正是这起投诉的核心所在。

sentences.en: was at the heart of what the complaint was about.
sentences.zh: 然后我们得知，在7月25日，

sentences.en: And then we learned that on July 25th,
sentences.zh: 特朗普与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基通了电话。

sentences.en: Trump had a phone call with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
sentences.zh: 在那次通话中，特朗普先后八次告诉泽连斯基，他应该调查这些指控，并与朱利安尼分享调查结果。

sentences.en: On eight different occasions on that call, Trump told Zelensky that he should investigate these allegations and share the findings with Giuliani.
sentences.zh: 我们知道乌克兰从特朗普政府那里想要的资金，在通话中被提及了吗？

sentences.en: And do we know if the money that Ukraine wanted from the Trump administration, whether that came up during the call?
sentences.zh: 我们不知道它是否被提及，但我们确实知道，就在本月初，特朗普政府将这笔资金发放给了乌克兰人。

sentences.en: We don't know whether it came up, but we do know that earlier this month, the Trump administration released that money to the Ukrainians.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我只是想把这些线索拼凑起来。

sentences.en: Mike, I just want to piece this together.
sentences.zh: 你描绘了这样一种情景：特朗普总统致电乌克兰总统，向他施压要求调查其政治对手的儿子。

sentences.en: You have laid out a scenario in which President Trump calls the president of Ukraine and presses him to investigate his political opponent's son.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，大家心知肚明的是，他掌控着乌克兰总统想要的那2.5亿美元援助，而他却在暗示乌克兰总统基本上帮他一个政治忙。

sentences.en: And all the while, it would very much be in the air that he controls $250 million that that president
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: of Ukraine wants, while he is proposing that that president of Ukraine basically do him a political favor.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》App，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 好的，这差不多就是截至周日该新闻的进展。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay, so that's more or less where the story stands on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普公开露面，就这一指控向媒体发表了讲话。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了一次很好的对话。

sentences.en: And then Trump comes out and addresses the media about the allegation.
sentences.zh: 我进行的对话很大程度上是祝贺性质的。

sentences.en: We had a great conversation.
sentences.zh: 他说他与乌克兰总统进行了谈话。

sentences.en: The conversation I had was largely congratulatory.
sentences.zh: 事实是我们不希望像副总统拜登和他的儿子这样的人在乌克兰制造并延续乌克兰本已存在的腐败。

sentences.en: He says that he had a conversation with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 提到了乔·拜登。

sentences.en: The fact that we don't want our people like Vice President Biden and his son creating to be the corruption already in the Ukraine and Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 但他所说的是，除非他们解雇那个正在调查他的儿子、他儿子的公司（也就是他儿子合作的公司）的检察官，否则他不会给乌克兰提供——我想是数十亿美元资金。

sentences.en: Brought up Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常不诚实的说法。

sentences.en: But what he said is that he wouldn't give, I think it was billions of dollars to Ukraine unless they fired the prosecutor who was looking at his son and his son's company,
sentences.zh: 并坚信存在未被彻查的真正的不当行为。

sentences.en: the company that his son works with.
sentences.zh: 因此，总统承认他与乌克兰总统有过一次谈话，在谈话中他抱怨了拜登，抱怨了拜登的儿子，并指控两人腐败。

sentences.en: And that's a great dishonest thing.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，对于那些认为总统曾施压泽连斯基调查其政敌的人来说，这感觉特朗普确实给了他们相当多的口实。

sentences.en: And believes that there is real wrongdoing that is not being examined.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the president acknowledges having a conversation with the president of Ukraine in which he complains
sentences.zh: 总统似乎为他的政治对手在试图调查他时提供了一条新的途径。

sentences.en: about Biden, complains about Biden's son, accuses the two of them of corruption.
sentences.zh: 特朗普经常希望让各种机构——无论是联邦调查局、司法部，还是本案中的外国——去调查他的政敌，并让他的政敌因这些调查而遭到玷污。

sentences.en: I have to say, for those who believe the president pressured Zelensky to investigate his rival, it certainly feels like Trump is giving them a fair bit to work with.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这符合我们以前在他身上看到过的一种模式。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 而现在他又在这样做，但与此同时，这也给了民主党人一个全新的议题，让他们在试图证明他腐败的努力中去加以推动。
